payload.title: A1 · Ik wil graag bestellen
payload.patternExplanation: Use Ik wil graag… to order politely. Say what you want after the phrase.

lines.dutch: In het café bekijk ik de kaart.
lines.english: In the cafe, I look at the menu.
Good afternoon, what would you like to drink?

lines.dutch: Ik wil graag een koffie met melk, alstublieft.
lines.english: I would like a coffee with milk, please.
lines.telugu: నాకు పాలతో ఒక కాఫీ కావాలి, దయచేసి.

lines.dutch: Natuurlijk. Wilt u er ook iets bij?
lines.english: Of course. Would you like something with it too?

lines.dutch: Ja, ik wil graag een broodje kaas.
lines.english: Yes, I would like a cheese roll.
lines.telugu: అవును, నాకు ఒక చీజ్ రోల్ కావాలి.

lines.dutch: Dat komt zo. U kunt straks betalen.
lines.english: That will come shortly. You can pay in a moment.
lines.telugu: అది కాసేపట్లో వస్తుంది. మీరు కొద్దిసేపటికి చెల్లించవచ్చు.
